div.head: Af 9.1
div.ab: A sy ðæt wite LX scill', oð ðæt angylde arise to XXX scill'; siððan hit to ðam arise ðæt angylde, siððan sy þæt wite CXX scill'.
Á sie þæt wite LX scill’, oð ðæt angylde árise to XXX scill’; siððan hit to ðam árise þæt angylde, siððan sie þæt wite CXX scill’.
Sit semper wita LX solid., donec angildum exurgat ad triginta sol.; postquam angildum ad id surgit (crescit), postea sit wita centum uiginti solidi.
Á sie þæt wite LX scill, oððæt angylde árise to XXX scill; siððan hit to ðam árise þæt angylde, siððan sie þæt wite CXX scill.
The fine shall always be 60 shillings until the single-recompense reaches 30 shillings; after the single-recompense reaches this amount or higher, then the fine shall be 120 shillings.
Until the value amounts to 30 shillings, the fine shall be 60 shillings in every case. When the [said] value amounts to this sum, the fine shall be 120 shillings.
The fine is always to be 60 shillings until the simple compensation rises to 30 shillings; when the simple compensation has risen to that, the fine is afterwards to be 120 shillings.
Das Strafgeld betrage jedesmal 60 Schill., bis das einfache Ersatzgeld auf 30 Schill. steigt; sobald es dazu steigt das Ersatzgeld, von da ab betrage das Strafgeld 120 Schill.
Let the fine always be 60 shillings, until the single compensation rises to 30 shillings; as soon as the compensation rises to that, from then on let the fine be 120 shillings.
